children: Warrenton, Virginia, was awarded a $500M firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for commercial counter-unmanned aerial systems and counter small-unmanned aerial systems capabilities.
Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Sept. 27, 2029.
Army Contracting Command, Detroit Arsenal, Michigan, is the contracting activity (W912CH-26-D-A082). (Awarded Sept. 28, 2026).

title: DroneShield secures $500M U.S. Army contract
